title: AnchorOperationsSummary
description: Group-level counts for the four Anchor Ops summary cards.

total.description: Total practitioners in the Anchor Group.

manualOverride.description: Practitioners with a manual override. Nonzero only once a recompute has observed an override on the row.

reviewRequired.description: Practitioners flagged for review. Nonzero only once a recompute has observed an override on the row and platform drift under it.
